elements.name: Retain panel visibility while switching tabs and parts

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` and `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartTwo.opd` are open in that order
the first part is active with the 3D Model ribbon expanded
the Parameters panel is visible
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon tab
the Parameters panel is still visible
the user activates the second part document
its 3D Model ribbon also shows the Parameters panel
the user returns to the first part document
its Parameters panel remains visible

elements.name: Hide and restore a panel while its expansion is pinned

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the Modify panel is visible with its additional commands expanded and pinned
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the user clears Modify in the panel list
the Modify panel and its expanded command area disappear
the panel list remains open with Modify unchecked
the user selects Modify in the panel list
the Modify panel returns to the ribbon
its additional command area is not open
the panel list remains open with Modify checked
the user presses Escape
the panel list closes
the user opens the Modify additional command area
the user clicks empty viewport space
the additional command area closes

elements.name: Switch ribbon tabs while the direct panel list is open

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
Modify is visible and Parameters is hidden
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the panel list shows Modify checked and Parameters unchecked
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the panel list closes
the View ribbon is displayed
the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon tab
the panel list remains closed
Modify remains visible and Parameters remains hidden

elements.name: Dismiss the panel selector and expansion with Escape

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with the Modify panel visible
the Modify additional command area is open
the user opens the direct panel selector
the panel list opens with Modify checked
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user presses Escape
the panel list closes
the Modify additional command area closes
the Modify panel remains visible

elements.name: Show and hides the Parameters panel during sketch editing

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the Sketch tab is active
the Parameters panel is hidden
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
Parameters is unchecked in the panel list
the user selects Parameters
the Parameters panel appears after Format and before Exit
the panel displays a large parameter symbol
the user opens the Create panel title context menu
the user opens Show Panels
the user selects Parameters
the Parameters panel is hidden again
the sketch remains in edit mode
